mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, supplier_id, attendance_date, work_type, name, roster_id, user_id, morning_working_time, morning_closing_time, afternoon_working_time, afternoon_closing_time, overtime_working_time, overtime_closing_time, stand_config_id, over_config_id, point, attend_status
mapper.select:
SELECT attendance_date as attendanceDate, sum(case when attend_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as 'standAbsenteeNumber', sum(case when attend_status !=1 and attend_status !=0 then 1 else 0 end) as 'standClockNumber', sum(case when attend_status !=0 then 1 else 0 end) as 'standTotalNumber', sum(case when over_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as 'overAbsenteeNumber', sum(case when over_status !=1 and over_status !=0 then 1 else 0 end) as 'overClockNumber', sum(case when over_status !=0 then 1 else 0 end) as 'overTotalNumber' FROM `mes_building_attendance` where bool_delete_enum = 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(attendance_date, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{monthDate}, '%Y-%m' )
AND supplier_id = #{supplierId}
group by attendance_date order by attendance_date desc

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN attend_status=2 or attend_status=4 or over_status=2 or over_status=4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as totalMete, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') and (attend_status=2 or attend_status=4 or over_status=2 or over_status=4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS currentMonthMete, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') and (attend_status=2 or attend_status=4 or over_status=2 or over_status=4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS lastMonthMete FROM `mes_building_attendance` where bool_delete_enum =0 and roster_id = #{rosterId}
